# dsh-skill-install

A DeepSeek Harness skill installer. From the Web settings page
(Settings → "Skills"), search GitHub

repositories by name or paste a repo URL, list the `SKILL.md` skills inside,
tick the ones you want,

and install them to a target directory. Integrates with the built-in skill-filesystem, so
installed
skills take effect immediately — no restart required.
中文
## Features
- **Search by name / paste a URL**: one input accepts a skill/repo name (searches repos by name), or

`owner/repo`
and `https://github.com/owner/repo` addresses.
- **Only matched repos**: search return

s concrete matching repositories; click "Open" to browse their skills.
There is no full-site discove

ry feed.
- **Selectable target, global by default**:
Targets are **global** (`<DSH_HOME>/skills`), **a workspace** (`<workspace dir>/.dsh/skills`, read f

rom the host registry), or **a custom absolute directory**.
- **Installed list**: grouped by target

directory, one-click removal.
- **Currently loaded skills**: the merged set from the built-in skill-

filesystem and this plugin (read-only).
- **Proxy (collapsed entry)**: configure a proxy address, te

st connectivity, or clear it; requests go through the
system `curl` when set, direct otherwise.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes; "Settings → Skills" shows the new page. This packag

e has
**zero external runtime dependencies** (`js-yaml` is bundled as a self-contained ESM build), s

o a GitHub install
needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.
## Runtime dependencies
- The host plugin is pure ESM with no external runtime dependencies (`js-yaml` is bundled in `js-yam

l.mjs`, MIT).
- Extracting the GitHub tarball needs system `tar` (built into Windows 10 1809+); usin
g a proxy needs `curl`.
## Skill-system integration
- Global / workspace installs write into the standard roots watched by skill-filesystem, so the watc

her hot-loads them;
- Custom directories are registered as an independent skill provider via `ctx.sk

ills.registerProvider`, using the
same discovery rules (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` or `<root>/<name>.m

d`), invalidated on install / remove / changes;
- All routes and providers are registered with `ctx.
effect`, so they are removed automatically on disable / reload.
